hook: The sound that makes you|*see ghosts*

lines.say: In the 1980s, an engineer named Vic Tandy worked in a lab in England that people said was haunted.
shots: q: old industrial lab building England night

lines.say: One night, he felt cold, uneasy, and saw a grey shape at the edge of his vision. When he turned to look, it was gone.
shots: q: blurred shadow corner dark room

lines.say: The next day he was fixing a fencing sword in a vise, and the blade started vibrating on its own.
He traced it to a new extractor fan. It was producing sound at nineteen cycles a second. Too low for humans to hear.
shots: line art: sound wave 19 Hz below hearing line

lines.say: When the fan was fixed, the feeling, and the ghost, disappeared.
Low sound like this, called infrasound, has been linked in some experiments to anxiety, chills and a sense of presence, and may even make the eyeball vibrate slightly.
shots: line art: eye outline with vibration lines

lines.say: Not every haunting is a fan. But some of them might be.
